tool.name: mumemto viz
tool.description: Visualize pangenome synteny from multi-MUM output
tool.command: mumemto viz -m '$mum_file' -o 'viz_output' #if $interactive: --interactive #end if && cp viz_output.png '$plot_output' #if $interactive: && cp viz_output.html '$interactive_output' #end if

param.name: mum_file
param.label: Input .mums file
param.help: Multi-MUM output from mumemto find (strict or partial multi-MUMs only)

param.name: interactive
param.label: Generate interactive plotly plot
param.help: Experimental: produces an HTML interactive plot in addition to the static PNG

tool.help:
# Mumemto: Visualization
Mumemto viz generates synteny visualization plots from `.mums` output files produced by mumemto find. It requires strict or partial multi-MUMs as input (not multi-MEMs).
## Input
- A `.mums` file from a mumemto find run (strict or partial multi-MUMs only).
## Options
- **Interactive plot:** Generate an experimental interactive plotly plot (HTML) in addition to the static PNG image.
## Output
- A PNG synteny visualization plot. - Optionally, an HTML interactive plotly plot.
For detailed usage, see the Mumemto wiki: https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki
@ATTRIBUTION@
